notes: Developer-authored contract for the third unreadable policy, fixed before implementing the candidate; provisional project reading policy, pending independent linguistic review. No synthesized audio. preserve and drop cover characters with no declared name, but an object the engine deliberately refused to interpret -- 20F, 11st, 2:1 -- passes through as written under both, so a caller who needs every segment sayable had no setting. read says whatever has a reading, drops what has none, and keeps punctuation: digits are spelled the way the project already spells an identifier (k007 → 케이영영칠), English letters stay as they are because English speech reads them, and the declared alphabet join decides the spacing. The default stays preserve and text mode is unaffected. Updated 2026-10-02 (project-owner decision): a short digit-first label (up to four digits and one to three letters, not a unit, meridiem, English ordinal or decade) is read as the number and the letter names instead of being left as written (20F 이십 에프; 20F{@address} 이십 층). Was: 이영에프 안내
